Scope of disclosures
This report presents the consolidated Pillar 3 disclosures of Allica Bank Limited (the Group) for the year-ended 31 
December 2025. Allica Bank Limited publishes these disclosures in accordance with the Capital Requirements 
Regulation (“the CRR”) Article 433b. These disclosures are prepared in accordance with the disclosure requirements 
set out in the Prudential Regulatory Authority’s (“PRA”) Rulebook. Allica Bank Limited is not a LREQ firm and is not 
subject to additional leverage ratio disclosure requirements. The disclosures should be read in conjunction with our 
Annual Report and Accounts for risk management and remuneration.
